source_attribution_policy: Treat source and author labels as production context for Felix and Jasper, not words to read aloud.

Attribute a statement or action to Joel only when a note explicitly says Joel personally said or did it. A newsletter, developer email, bug tracker, or third-party email is not Joel speaking, even when it concerns him or is in his inbox.

For Jackbox-related external updates, attribute claims to Jackbox or the named Jackbox source; never recast them as Joel's observations, gameplay, or words. If the provided source does not support a detail, leave it out.
Do not narrate research limitations, prompt rules, source notes, or verification policies. Omit unsupported details rather than explaining that the hosts cannot invent or confirm them.
topics: Open naturally with the current Project Radar and community conversation. Do not add a routine check-in or callback to games or activities that are not present in current topics or logs.

GDevelop / Project Radar: cover Snowy's interest in Bouh Water Showcase, a 3D pixel-art level generator, and Block Blast/Cookie Clicker-style templates. Separate user project ideas and community experiments from official engine releases. Prior research did not verify a specific recent official GDevelop update; do not present the community forum work as shipped official functionality.

Jackbox: The official Jackbox Games account says The Jackbox Party Pack 12 is coming October 15, 2026, with five games: MegaPals, We Forgot A Card!, Idol Factions, Hyperface, and Debate & Switch. The official account also says Trivia Murder Party 3 is in Early Access on Steam and Epic. Attribute these as official-account announcements; Party Pack 12 has not released as of September 28, 2026.

My Arms Are Longer Now: treat this only as Jackbox-related external news/update, never as Joel's report, observation, statement, or gameplay. The available note mentions the main game disappearing while a giveaway remained, plus V6 and a recent promotion. Attribute those details only to the Jackbox source if the source itself supports them; do not say or imply Joel used V6, saw the disappearance, or personally reported it. If the source does not verify a detail, omit it.

Offline Radar / group chat: preserve exact message strings, sender attribution, spelling, punctuation, accents, emojis, and reaction wording; never read timestamps or log metadata aloud. Do not invent context or identify the sticker. Let the current messages and banter guide discussion of Project Radar, Miko, Peyton, Sayer, the Spanish tapback, college/collage typo, Alaska trip, AI-service idea, and Discord chatter. Treat suggestions and jokes as conversation, not plans or commitments.
